name: chrome-v1
prompt: A single premium 3D app icon glyph of a twin-engine widebody airliner on a fully transparent background. Strict orthographic top-down plan view from directly above, NO perspective, NO tilt, nose pointing STRAIGHT UP, perfectly mirror-symmetric left and right about the vertical centre line, centred, filling about 80 percent of the frame height. Proportions, chunky and friendly like a die-cast toy but realistic: a wide plump fuselage about one seventh of the wingspan in width, a very round blunt nose dome, a smoothly tapered round tail cone; wings mounted at mid fuselage, swept back about 30 degrees, moderately short, with smooth upturned blended winglets; exactly two round engine nacelles, one under each wing, showing in front of the wing leading edge close to the fuselage; a conventional tail: a small swept horizontal stabiliser with rounded tips. Material: mirror-polished chrome and liquid silver, crisp white specular highlights and deep charcoal reflections, strong volume, single soft studio key light coming from the LEFT side. Restrained, precise, in the style of an icon Apple designs for its own products. No shadow, no background, nothing else.

name: chrome-v2
prompt: Isolated on a fully transparent background: a chunky simplified chrome airliner, the hero glyph of a premium Apple-style app icon. View: exactly from directly above, orthographic, nose pointing straight up toward the top edge, the aircraft perfectly bilaterally symmetric. Twin-engine widebody of our own proportions: broad rounded fuselage, bulbous round nose, wings swept 30 degrees with gently curved blended winglets, two plump engine pods under the wings set close to the body, conventional rounded tailplane. Every edge softly rounded, no seams, no detail. Highly polished silver chrome with sharp bright highlights running along the fuselage and wing leading edges and dark reflections, studio key light from the left. Fills about 80 percent of the frame height. No shadow, no background.

name: chrome-v3
prompt: Redraw the same chrome airliner as the reference, keeping its polished chrome material, crisp highlights, plump rounded volumes and twin under-wing engines, but change the view: strict orthographic top-down view from directly above with the nose pointing STRAIGHT UP, perfectly mirror-symmetric left and right, no perspective or tilt. Make the fuselage slightly wider and the nose rounder, wings swept 30 degrees with blended winglets, conventional horizontal tail with rounded tips, no visible tall fin. Key light from the left. Centred, filling about 80 percent of the frame height, fully transparent background, no shadow.
